title: Layered verification in Tamarin: theories and results for time enforcement in self-orchestrated business processes
description: Tamarin theories, the scripts that run them and the summaries of every run for two TDK 2026 papers: Bottom-Up Formal Verification Of Temporal Constraints In Self-Orchestrated Business Processes and Scalable Byzantine Fault-Tolerant Time Enforcement For Decentralized Business Collaborations. One theory per layer of the system model (layers 1-3, 4, 5, 6 and 7), four negative controls, and generated layer-6 models of 1, 2, 3, 4 and 8 times the size of the running example for the scalability measurement. Run with Tamarin 1.12.0 and Maude 3.5.1; the Docker image and just reproduce regenerate every table and figure. The full proof files are not included; the scripts regenerate them.
